resources.string: On. Only the current unsent token is editable. Disable before secrets or immediate-input apps. enforce-char-based-input takes precedence.

Your keyboard sees typed input. Termux-Avic requests no personalized learning; the keyboard may ignore that request. Terminal output and history are never supplied to the keyboard.

Check suggested commands before pressing Enter. Only the current unsent token can be corrected. Letters wait for a space, punctuation, Enter, or control action. Disable this mode before passwords, tokens, private commands, vim command mode, games, or apps needing immediate character input. The local preview can appear even when a program turns echo off.

The enforce-char-based-input property still takes precedence. Changes apply when you return to the terminal; termux-reload-settings also works.
